items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So, all right, Briggs got a job for me to entertain at a place called The Paragola--Oostende-- East end.

ctx.x:
He, Arthur Briggs was a New Yorker
but I think originally he was from there.--I mean West Indian--Caribbean person.
So, all right, Briggs got a job for me to entertain at a place called The Paragola--Oostende-- East end.
Right across from Dover. You can see the boat coming in over there at 5:00 o'clock every day.
Englishmen would come to Oostende (phonetic) for their vacations, you see. / The working class people. Now, this place that we were playing in, it was for the rich people, the casino, they had a symphony…
